pairs.registryProposal: The agent-memory standard assumes a unified local agent memory loop, whereas hybrid studio architectures that store local episodic logs while delegating consolidation and sleep cycles to external desktop runtimes (e.g. Personas) create an asymmetric boundary where host-side memory operations are structurally incomplete without the external runner.
